defect: The Git child-process record converts a reported spawn error to null whenever status is zero. Linux broker diagnostics observed spawnSync git EPERM and status 0 together. A status-only decision could therefore admit a contradictory execution as successful.
evidence: Earlier retained Linux logs reported spawnSync git EPERM alongside status 0; native Windows diagnostics for the candidate reported ordinary success with null errors.
regression: FWE-017 contradictory Git spawn diagnostics retain raw status and block; pre-fix seed RED is retained in publication-spawn-diagnostics-red-seed-20261005.log (exit 1)
resolution: Preserve the actual status, signal, and error in each command record. Append the raw record before rejecting any reported spawn error or signal, regardless of numeric status. Keep normal zero-status, null-error Windows success valid. Do not synthesize a nonzero exit code.
